title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.23696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23696v1 公告类型：新 摘要：尽管生成模型在建模复杂数据方面取得了显著成功，但它们面临一个根本性的权衡。全局方法能够捕捉完整的结构连贯性，但计算成本高昂，而局部模型效率高但往往无法重现长程相关性和全局连贯性。重正化群（RG）通过无缝连接不同长度尺度上的空间结构来弥合这一差距，在每一步保留准局部描述的同时维持长程相关性。我们引入了重正化群流匹配（RGFM），这是一种生成框架，系统性地在不同空间尺度上组织数据生成。通过使用精确的RG流作为概率路径，RGFM逐步从长波长结构生成数据到短波长结构。为了协调可扩展性与全局结构，我们利用了RG的两个关键特性：准局部性和尺度分离。我们严格地...
tldr: 本文提出重正化群流匹配（RGFM）生成框架，利用重正化群的准局部性和尺度分离特性，以精确RG流为概率路径，实现从长波到短波结构的可扩展局部生成建模，兼顾全局连贯性与计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework leveraging quasi-locality and scale separation of the renormalization group to progressively generate data from long- to short-wavelength structures, achieving scalable local modeling with global coherence.
